pokedexEntries.ru: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.

pokedexEntries.sa: This POKéMON pulls out the leaf on its head and makes a flute with it. The sound of NUZLEAF’s flute strikes fear and uncertainty in the hearts of people lost in a forest.

pokedexEntries.frlg: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

pokedexEntries.em: A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

pokedexEntries.dpp: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
